request: Tier 4 of nightly-vehicle-telemetry (Option A, user 2026-07-11): add a public snapshot READ port to internal/telemetry returning the latest stored snapshot per vehicle for a given account (DISTINCT ON batch query), read-only over vehicle_snapshots, pgtype->domain mapped inside the module. Prerequisite for tier 5 (gateway displays nightly data).
apply_plan: Mirror tier 3's interleaved regen. Wave 1 worker (Sonnet): tasks 1 (query.sql), 4 (Reader interface in telemetry.go) — pure, no regen. Leader: task 2 (make sqlc regen). Wave 2 worker (Sonnet): tasks 3 (store seam + pgStore + rowToSnapshot/mapping), 5 (NewReader in reader.go), 6 (offline reader_test), 7 (DATABASE_URL-gated store test) — need generated telemetrydb; serial in one worker (shared files + dep chain). Task 8 (AGENTS.md Reader) already delivered by the artifacts worker -> done. Leader: task 9 verification.

tasks.title: Add LatestSnapshotsByAccount :many (DISTINCT ON (tesla_id) ... ORDER BY tesla_id, captured_at DESC) to internal/telemetry/db/query.sql
tasks.notes: Appended LatestSnapshotsByAccount :many query to internal/telemetry/db/query.sql using DISTINCT ON (tesla_id) ... WHERE account_id = @account_id ORDER BY tesla_id, captured_at DESC. Full explicit column list (no SELECT *). Doc comment explains the DISTINCT ON approach, the (account_id, tesla_id, captured_at) index coverage, and the N+1 anti-pattern it avoids.

Updated fakeStore in service_test.go with no-op stub for the new method. go build ./internal/telemetry/... clean.

review.brief: Review the completed change telemetry-add-snapshot-read-port (tier 4 of nightly-vehicle-telemetry): a NEW public READ port on internal/telemetry returning the latest stored snapshot per vehicle for an account. Read the DIFF, not the whole module. Validate per the doc pack (CLAUDE.md, ai/architecture.md, ai/go-conventions.md, ai/agentic-workflow.md, internal/telemetry/AGENTS.md): (1) BOUNDARY/PORT — Reader is a clean public interface (LatestSnapshotsByAccount(ctx, accountID uuid.UUID) ([]Snapshot, error)); pgtype NEVER leaks out of the module (confined to dbStore/mapping.go); no telemetrydb type in any public signature; the module imports nothing forbidden (no gateway/accountdb/internal-config/html/templ); read-only — NO new migration/table/column. (2) QUERY CORRECTNESS — DISTINCT ON (tesla_id) ... WHERE account_id ORDER BY tesla_id, captured_at DESC genuinely returns the NEWEST snapshot per vehicle scoped to the account; covered by the existing (account_id,tesla_id,captured_at) index; no N+1. (3) MAPPING FIDELITY — rowToSnapshot maps pgtype->domain correctly: sentry_mode pgtype.Bool->*bool with nil<->NULL fidelity (Valid==false => nil), Timestamptz->time.Time, int32->int; empty result -> non-nil empty slice + nil error. (4) UNITS — Snapshot keeps miles API-native; Km()/Kmh() companions only; NO km field/column introduced. (5) TESTS — offline reader_test.go uses a fake store seam (no DB/network/Tesla call) covering latest-per-vehicle, empty account, error propagation, sentry nil fidelity; DATABASE_URL-gated store test self-skips when unset and, when set, proves latest-wins + multi-vehicle + cross-account isolation; tasks-exploration test-free rule intact (no tests on Raw*/cmd/explore-tesla-api). (6) SPEC/TASKS coverage — delta spec ADDED requirements with GIVEN/WHEN/THEN match behavior; every tasks.md checkbox reflects real completion; strict validate passes. ANTI-GAMING: no task title/criterion weakened or deleted; workers marked only their own tasks; leader-integrated make sqlc (task 2) regen is legit. Default to a cheaper model and ESCALATE ON DOUBT: return changes-requested for leader re-review rather than approving anything uncertain. You alone set review.status/reviewer-approved.
